description: On the bed in front of you are a yellow bowl, a small clear plastic container, a red “12” token, a small yellow-and-green toy piece, and a green block. The left hand stays relaxed near the lower left, while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the gray item inside the yellow bowl (right-hand object), lifts it out, moves leftward, and places it into the clear plastic container before letting go.
